About this item

  • Aluminum Build That Won't Wobble - A tank-solid brushed aluminum board keeps every keystroke steady during intense sessions, unlike the flex you get from plastic-frame keyboards.
  • Swap Switches Without Soldering, Comfortable Out of the Box - The upgraded socket accepts almost any 3-pin or 5-pin switch, and the stock Brown switches give a soft tactile bump for all-day typing comfort.
  • Vibrant RGB for a True eSports Vibe - 20 preset lighting modes with adjustable brightness and flow speed give your desk the glow of a dedicated gaming rig.
  • Full Anti-Ghosting, Wide System Compatibility - 104 keys register accurately during rapid combos, and plug-and-play wired connection works across Windows and Mac with no drivers required.
  • Pro Software for Even Deeper Customization - Want to go beyond the onboard presets? The companion software lets you design custom RGB effects and program macros with your own keybindings.

From the manufacturer


About Redragon:

Redragon is a high-value brand for gaming peripheral and dedicates to provide high-performance gaming products to global customers.

As one of the leading company with 20 years manufacturing experienced, Redragon innovated in world first-class industrial design and quality, with strong R&D and global sales team devoting, its aim to bring the best service and quality of products.

Redragon K556 Devarajas

Find the Victory

- To compete at the highest level, you need the fastest mechanical keyboard there is. The Redragon K556 RGB isn't your average gaming keyboard.

- It is loaded with features including heavy duty metal and ABS construction, double-shot injection molded keycaps, high-end switches with mechanical ultra-last springs, crisp and bright adjustable RGB LED backlighting and a splash-resistant design. Fantastic mechanical gaming keyboard and perfect for whatever battles you might face.

  • Redragon Mechanical Switches with 60±15g actuation force.
  • 50 million keystroke life span.
  • RGB customizable backlighting with 16 million customizable color options.
  • Cable management organizer.

K556 RGB Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

Legendary Redragon mechanical gaming keyboard performance gives gaming players extra dominant position and unique competiveness.

Redragon Mechanical Brown Switches

Fully original brown switches with fast linear actuation and seamless Online Experience.

Anti-ghosting with 104 Standard Keys

Fully anti-ghosting keys deliver reliably accurate performance to players without any program error.

Fully Anodized Aluminum Frame Brushed

Extreme durability ensures that players do whatever they would like.

Manufactured to Perfection

Over-engineered and built to take a beating, with laser-engraved keys & gaming switches.

USB Golden Plated Port

With USB golden plated port to ensure the stability of data transmission.

No delay, no error.

Multiple RGB Themes

Themes backlights to reach the 18 backlits modes.

Personalized backlight model can be set up as well.

Special Keyboard “Designer” Fun

The key-mover and additional 8 backup switches are free to get to design your own special keyboard.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
